description: Sybil / burst request detector daemon. Reads mesh_events WHERE event_type IN (assessment_requested, build_complete) grouped by json_extract_string(payload, '$.server_id') AND date_trunc('minute', created_at) via ws_query. Detect: >20 assessment requests for same server_id within 60s = burst_attack. Also detect: 10+ NEW server_ids registered within 5 minutes from same registry_source = coordinated_registration (classic Sybil seeding). For burst: ws_write mcp_threat_associations {threat_type=sybil_burst, severity=HIGH, evidence=request_count+window}. For coordinated_registration: ws_write with threat_type=coordinated_registration, severity=HIGH. Also: check if multiple servers share identical description text (copy-paste Sybil) via ws_query mcp_server_registry self-join on TRIM(description). Poll 300s (5min for near-realtime detection). Heartbeat.
